launch_blockers.question: Can the launch contour be lawfully operated by an individual NPD taxpayer in its actual product form, or does the offered service constitute licensed educational activity / require IP or another operator form?
launch_blockers.why: Article 91 of Federal Law 273-FZ expressly excludes from education licensing individual entrepreneurs who conduct educational activity directly; the current owner authority names an NPD launch operator, not an admitted IP education contour.
must_be_true_before_go_live: legal classification of the paid service is recorded
operator form is compatible with that classification
public offer/product claims match the accepted classification
no false claim of licensed educational-program status

launch_blockers.question: Is the operator notification/registry state under Article 22 of Federal Law 152-FZ complete for the actual launch processing?
must_be_true_before_go_live: operator identity/address/contact are known
purposes/categories/data-subject categories/processors/databases are inventoried
RKN notification is filed before processing unless current counsel confirms a specific statutory exception
changes to notification are tracked
policy is published with unrestricted access on every Eksamio page that collects personal data or by a persistent accessible link
policy identifies operator, purposes, data categories, legal grounds, processing actions, retention/deletion rules and processors
policy matches actual implementation
legal basis is assigned per processing purpose rather than one blanket basis
where consent is used it is specific, informed and separately presented from the offer/other documents
consent fact/version/time can be proven and withdrawal path exists
recording/systematization/accumulation/storage/update/extraction of Russian-citizen personal data use databases in Russia except a documented statutory exception
production PostgreSQL and canonical identity/PEIS storage are in the admitted Russia contour
browser or foreign-provider state never becomes the primary personal-data database

providers: Yandex Cloud / AI Studio / SpeechKit / Postbox
must_be_true_before_go_live: each provider role and data flow is documented
processor/third-party terms permit the intended processing
data minimization and retention settings match public disclosures
foreign or cross-border transfer, if any, is separately reviewed before activation
public documents state that learner audio is processed only transiently for the current voice interaction and is not stored by Eksamio
no voiceprint, speaker embedding or reusable acoustic representation is persisted
provider configuration/terms are reviewed for unintended provider retention
production smoke confirms Eksamio persistence count remains zero
operator identity and contact details are disclosed
service scope and limitations are accurately described
30-day and 90-day access, price, payment methods, activation moment and no auto-renew are explicit
refund/cancellation/technical-failure rules do not reduce statutory consumer rights
payment action is linked to the current offer version and acts as an unambiguous acceptance only after legal review
no marketing promise guarantees an exam result
every admitted NPD receipt-producing payment creates/transmits the required receipt through the accepted FNS/My Tax contour
receipt is delivered to the payer through an admitted electronic channel
refund/correction flow preserves fiscal correctness
Robokassa/Robocheki merchant settings are accepted against the actual operator status
student age and payer/contracting-party relationship are handled explicitly
the checkout does not assume that every 14-17-year-old can independently enter a paid contract outside statutory exceptions
for under-14 users, contracting/personal-data flow is handled through a lawful representative where required
the product may allow a minor learner with a separate legally capable payer without exposing learner drafts/dialogs to the payer by default
a personal-data incident contact and runbook exist
24-hour initial and 72-hour internal-investigation notification clocks are operationalized for qualifying incidents
subject requests for access/correction/cessation/deletion can be received and tracked
retention/deletion operations are executable

owner_data_needed_for_public_documents: operator legal name/FIO exactly as used in contracts
operator status and registration details accepted for launch
operator postal/legal address required by the accepted service classification
final paid AI analysis price if offered at launch
